patch_list: Bypass Android Auto certificate checks
Bypasses the Car App Library host certificate validation so Yanosik works on Android Auto.
Remove Yanosik ads
Removes banner ads, splash/start adverts and advert-based navigation POIs.
Remove Yanosik radio
Removes the built-in Radio Yanosik from the main screen and the map button.
Unlock Yanosik PRO
Reports an active premium entitlement and unlocks the PRO-only settings (view after launch, floating icon).

patch_list: Less tracking

Cuts down on analytics, ad reports, location targeting, Wi-Fi/app scans and crash uploads. Also blocks RevenueCat, so purchases and subscription syncing stop working. Maps and login still go online and may send your location or identifiers.
Local PRO
Unlocks the app's local PRO settings and hides the Switch to PRO toggle. Doesn't create a purchase or unlock server-only perks.
No banner ads
Removes banners from the map, navigation and home screen, including the empty ad space. Road alerts and route controls stay.
No startup ads
Skips ads when Yanosik opens, including cached ones. Normal startup messages and account checks still work.
No voice ads
Mutes sponsored audio and spoken ads. Directions and road warnings still play.
Vibe settings & less PRO spam
